classes_exercised.attribution: Blocked state resolved. The prior UID-level discrimination was caused by Android NetworkPolicyManagerService app-standby and background power-saving firewall rules (netd eBPF chain fw_standby), which denied all TCP traffic for non-whitelisted app UIDs when running on a passcode-locked or sleeping device (UID=10636 blocked_state={blocked=APP_STANDBY|APP_BACKGROUND,allowed=NONE,effective=APP_STANDBY|APP_BACKGROUND}). Exempting the package via dumpsys deviceidle whitelist +com.hopdemo clears the firewall drop rule, enabling bi-directional TCP communication and verified message delivery.
